title: East Gem - Close to Food & Venues - Yard For Dogs!
description:
Welcome to your perfect East Nashville getaway! Nestled in one of the city’s most vibrant, creative, and rapidly growing neighborhoods, right around the block from a top brewery, this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom single-family cottage blends modern style with cozy, neighborhood charm. Whether you’re here to explore Nashville's world-class music scene, dive into the local culinary landscape, or just unwind in a stylish home away from home, this property serves as an ideal basecamp.

The space
There is 2 bedrooms, both have queens beds with high quality mattresses (one is Casper, one is zinus with a Tempurpedic topper). The living space holds a couch that is a pull out queen mattress. There is one full bathroom and one half bathroom.  

While it can technically sleep 6, please note there is only 1 full bathroom (and one half) and plan accordingly.

Other things to note
Stays longer than 7 days will be charged a $50 cleaning fee every 7 days, and will need to allow the cleaner access to the property to be cleaned every 7 days.
